MyCrypto is a web-based interface for managing Ethereum wallets and interacting with smart contracts on public blockchains. MyCrypto is non-custodial, so users keep control of their own keys. MyCrypto is open-source software.

Melon is a protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain for creating and managing investment funds through smart contracts. Melon enables asset managers to issue tokenized funds without a traditional fund administrator. Melon operates as a decentralized application with no central intermediary.

Etherisc is a decentralized insurance platform built on the Ethereum blockchain. Etherisc provides reusable insurance product templates implemented as smart contracts. Etherisc uses smart contracts to automate claims and payouts without a central insurer.

Circle's Arc is a blockchain developed by Circle for stablecoin-based financial applications. Circle's Arc is designed as a layer-1 public blockchain.

Injective is a layer-1 blockchain designed for decentralized finance applications. Injective is built on the Cosmos SDK and supports on-chain order books and decentralized exchange functionality. Injective is a public blockchain open to permissionless participation.
